strings.en: Let the heart... be at peace...
The fierceness overflowing from within him...
You mustn't fill your heart with obsession...!
So you'd surrender yourself to your fixation...!
Truly Siddha... I can't let my guard down...!
What lies behind her pride is...
Dark ambition swirls in your heart...!
What you've done can't be forgiven...!
I'll strike down this karma stained with ambition...!
You may feign calm, but you can't hide your turmoil.
I won't be fooled by outward behavior...!
What lies behind that resolve... is...!
I won't let you quench your thirst...!
I must pull it away from the source of calamity...!
I have to hurry to Rabulpaila...!
Those devoted to Herluga.../　This battle is unavoidable...
Despite its appearance, that is an evil being...!
The evil Bhujanga must be destroyed...!
If I let wicked arts disturb my heart...!
Something... like a will is at work...?
That Zovorg unit is bound by a dark shadow...
No one is aboard that machine...
A dragon descended from another world... that is...
I'll shatter the dragon soul dwelling in the crystal...!
Skull Knight... I can't leave that unchecked...!
I can't accept/　the truth you've arrived at...!
I won't let you destroy the harmony/　with the world humanity has built...!
We have plenty of Zovorg unit data samples.
With the data Lieutenant Yon provided...!
I won't let you go any further.
The hostility they direct at us... this is...!
If I let the Big Shoulder get close...!
Thorn... an opponent I can't back down from.
That is... a mass of malice...
I mustn't be overwhelmed/　by this congealed malice...!
That... shouldn't exist in this world.
I must hurry and purify the Ida Type...!
Ares Geist... the will sleeping deep within...
I have to pull Ares Geist away/　from the Cross Gate...!
...Focus the mind on a single point...
Kuh...!/　Can I not hold my asana any longer...?
I... I can't go down here...!
I-I still haven't taught everyone yoga!/　I can't go down here...
Aah...!/　I have to... focus my mind...!
A throne seized by force alone is hollow...!
N-No...! I can't stand against that power...!!
The Cross Gate's power could/　upset this world's harmony...!
That power will destroy all harmony...!
I must keep my heart calm...
Not enough to disturb my heart...
I can't let this disturb my breathing...
The frame's undamaged. I can go on...
Oh no...!/　I have to regain my asana...
Ngh...! Their hostility threw me off...!
No...! If I get flustered,/　I'll leave an opening...!
I need to focus more deeply...!
Ugh, if my balance of heart and breath is disrupted...
Taking his momentum head-on is dangerous.
This is... the power of a Fury knight...!
If he becomes emperor, ruin will come again...!
So fickle, it's hard to read the next move...!
I can't back down over this much either.
If craving swallows me, I'll lose my peace of mind.
There's no way the Cross Gate's power/　can be controlled...!
The Crystal Dragoon found/　an opening in my heart...?!
I can't be swallowed/　by the Skull Knight's darkness...!
If I take too long, the Lamaris will...!
That's not enough.../　to shake my heart or my asana.
...Looks like I should switch/　to a different asana.
I knew it.../　Is this asana too much to manage?
Oh? I couldn't fully dodge it? I see...
Was changing my asana a mistake?
I read the movement, yet I couldn't fully dodge...!
The Emperor Unit's tuning isn't complete yet...?
That composure will create a crack.
I suppose you don't want me near the Cross Gate.
If I'm caught by wicked arts...!
I mustn't take that hostility head-on...!
It seems they have data too...
Minor damage... I'll keep drawing the enemy in...
With my mind's eye... I see through...
...I haven't been training/　for nothing, you know.
...I'll let that hostility flow past me.
I'm reading the flow of the field.
So-Des... I won't show you any opening in my heart...!
Piercing hostility... to keep dodging it...!
I must see through their true aim...!
You have no right to interfere with me...
Not one to panic just because I dodged.
Your lust for blood is showing too much.
You seem drunk on power, Herluga.
It isn't the first time I've seen such arts.
Refined hostility... its movements are easy to read.
An evil conviction... I can't let it pierce me...!
I can't obey the will dwelling in that...!
I've already analyzed that machine's data.
I must draw in as many enemies as I can...
I can't let the Lamaris latch onto me...!
With that much malice moving, I can't help but sense it.
You'll never be able to catch me.
You missed.../　because your mind is in turmoil.
I can't afford to get hit that easily.
It's so easy to read... your hostility...
Maybe you should study yoga too?
You may suppress your emotions, but not your heart...
This intense urge to destroy is...!
Now that the enemy's heart is shaken...!
Viletta, I'll back you up too...
Tasuku, leave the rest to me...
Ryoto, leave the rest to me...
Rio, let me lend you my strength...
Latune, leave the rest to me...
Lamia, I'll take it from here.
Lieutenant Hugo, leave the rest to me.
Aqua, I'll lend you a hand.
Rim, leave the rest to me.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
If I lean too far toward rajas...!
Arado, you need to focus more...!
I've read... every move you make!
Padma Asana... I can sense the enemy...
Through the Ida, give me power...!
I'll shoot right through your karma!
A combo attack from Raptor and Bison!
Open the eye of the heart...!
Siddhasana... the movement of all things...
I'll show you the dance of the phoenix...!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Would you like to try yoga too?
How 'bout I float ya in Fish Pose!
It seems the stars weren't in your favor.
Focus my mind... here I go!
Feel the energy of all things...
None can escape the mind's eye...!
